what: the corpus lane's map of the readings that point to another entry, kept here byte for byte in the folder the lane keeps it in: each reading classed, and for a pointer the entry it names and that entry's first English in the source's own order. tools/bake-form-of-pills-v1.mjs folds it, under the owner's rulings, into the map the card reads (data/form-of-pills-v1.json)
note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the bytes taken hash to it. The map replaces the one of relay v101 (form-of/zone-pills-v1.2.jsonl), which was read from outside this tree; each line keeps what that map resolved beside the new resolution, as resolved_in_v1_2
